text:
Sophie: Kicking off NewHorizon POC — sales asked for a perf run. Target: sustained 250 qps, avg request ~512 tokens, peak bursts to 2k qps (5s bursts). Need final load plan, expected tail latency, and hosted vs reserved pricing by EOD. @alex @liam @nora

Alex: On it. Propose 3-phase sweep:
1) smoke: 50→250 qps, 10m
2) sustained: 250 qps, 60m
3) burst: 2k qps, 10x5s bursts with 30s cooldowns between.
Use model `redwood-2B-q4` as baseline; fallback `redwood-1B-quant` for cost sims. Sample runner:```bash
vegeta attack -rate=250 -duration=60m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > results_250.json
# burst example
vegeta attack -rate=2000 -duration=5s -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report > burst_run1.txt
```
Config notes: `batch_size=8`, `max_seq=1024`, `kv_cache=true`. For sustained runs set `max_workers=4`/pod; for burst increase to `8`. Pin model to a build sha before the run.

Liam: Ops notes: recommended Dedicated pool for predictable numbers. For 250 qps sustained we expect end-to-end p50 ~350-450ms, p95 ~700-900ms for ~512-token responses on 2xA100-class nodes (depends on kernel selection & batching). Bursts will spike tail latencies 2–3x unless we pre-warm.
- Pre-warm: spin extra pods ~2m before scheduled flood.
- Autoscale: aggressive scale-up on 80% cpu/queue and keep a small hot pool.
- Rate-limiter: set per-customer token bucket to avoid single-tenant floods.
I'll size the pool and open a provisioning ticket if we go Dedicated.

Nora: Security heads-up: NewHorizon flagged PHI. Requirements: SOC2 evidence, SAML SSO, CMK/KMS for envelope keys, audit logs retained 13 months, and optional HSM for key wrapping on Private. If they insist on Private deployment we need infra checklist + one-time install window. Please have Sales fill the security questionnaire: https://redwood.example/secq/newhorizon (sections: infra, crypto, dataflow).

Sophie: Pricing ask — Sales wants ballpark monthly figures for hosted vs reserved (committed 250 qps). Alex, can you give quick numbers?

Alex: Quick roughs (estimate only):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ~ $35k/mo for sustained 250 qps (includes token costs + burst buffer).
- Reserved (Dedicated commit, 2-node pool): ~ $18k/mo commit + marginal per-token usage for bursts.
- Private (on-prem): one-time platform fee ~$75k + infra OPEX (dependent on customer infra).
These are back-of-envelope; we'll refine after the smoke run metrics.

deploy-bot: Environment created: `env-newhorizon-poc` → cluster `redwood-dedicated-stg-37`. Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runs/newhorizon-poc (artifacts will appear under runs/4329991234).

Sophie: Next steps / action items:
- Alex: run smoke today and attach raw results to the runbook.
- Liam: size Dedicated pool and open provisioning ticket if needed; plan pre-warm steps.
- Nora: send SQA link and confirm if PHI forces Private deployment.
- Sales: review pricing draft and share with prospect by EOD.
Demo window tentatively Thurs 11am PT — I’ll send invite. @alex @liam @nora please ack. :thumbsup:

Alex: Ack, starting smoke now.
Liam: Ack — I'll post sizing ticket in ~30m.
Nora: Ack — sending the questionnaire to Sales and legal.
Sophie: Thanks all — I'll update thread when the smoke artifacts are uploaded.
